events.event: The IHSG closed October at 5,057.05 on 30 October, down 0.80% on the day, 16.70% over the month and 41.52% year to date, as MSCI downgrade fears kept pressure on the market.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,057.05 (-41.01 pts, -0.80%) · Oct -16.70% from 6,071.14 · week -7.03% · YTD -41.52% · value Rp11.65 T, 37.62 B shares · 523 fell/187 rose · foreign total net sell Rp140.27 B
events.why_it_matters: The index lost one-sixth of its value in a single month, which hits retail portfolios and pension/mutual funds.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets (Kontan, FXStreet-ID, Mediakompeten) ran month-end recaps

events.event: Foreigners stayed net sellers on 30 October, dumping BBRI and TLKM while buying GOTO, BUMI and MDKA, extending the sell-off that followed the MSCI proposal.
events.key_numbers: Total net sell Rp140.27 B · regular market net sell Rp172.43 B · top net sell BBRI Rp206.5 B, TLKM Rp119.5 B, AMMN Rp59.3 B · top net buy GOTO Rp54.5 B, BUMI Rp40.4 B, MDKA Rp39.5 B · 29 Oct regular-market net sell Rp1.52 T (Kontan)
events.why_it_matters: Foreign outflows from big banks are what pulls the index and the rupiah down together.

events.event: The rupiah closed weaker at Rp18,147 per US dollar on 30 October as investors reacted to Trump's signals on military options against Iran, domestic student protests and strong US data.
events.key_numbers: Spot close Rp18,147 (-10 pts, -0.06%) · week -0.37% · JISDOR Rp18,138 · 29 Oct close Rp18,137 · intraday 29 Oct high Rp18,185 · US Q3 GDP +3.4% (forecast 3.2%) · core PCE 3.1% y/y
events.why_it_matters: A rupiah above Rp18,000 raises prices of imported goods, fuel and overseas tuition.

events.event: Currency analyst Ibrahim Assuaibi projects the rupiah will trade between Rp18,000 and Rp18,320 per dollar in the week from 2 November, citing student protests, inflation risk, oil and Fed expectations.
events.key_numbers: Range Rp18,000-18,320 · CME FedWatch: 83% probability of a Fed hike in December (as quoted) · key events: BPS October inflation, US midterms 3 Nov, oil prices
events.why_it_matters: Tells ordinary people what to expect for imported prices next week; single analyst forecast, not a prediction by us.

events.event: Reports say Trump has hinted new strikes on Iran could come after the 3 November US midterm elections, after CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper briefed him at the White House on 29 October.
events.key_numbers: US midterms 3 Nov 2026 · briefing Thursday 29 Oct with Defense Secretary Hegseth · rupiah weakened on the signals
events.why_it_matters: A new US-Iran escalation would push oil and fuel costs and weigh on the rupiah.

events.event: US data on 29-30 October showed Q3 GDP growth of 3.4% y/y and core PCE inflation at 3.1%, strengthening bets that the Fed may hike again, which pressures emerging-market currencies.
events.key_numbers: US Q3 GDP +3.4% y/y (forecast 3.2%, prior 2.2%) · core PCE +0.3% m/m, 3.1% y/y (prior 3.0%) · FedWatch Dec hike probability 83% (as quoted by Kontan) · Fed held 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Higher US rates draw money out of Indonesia and weaken the rupiah.

events.event: MSCI is scheduled to announce its November index rebalancing on 12 November, which investors watch for changes to Indonesian constituents amid foreign outflow concerns; FTSE Russell's follow-up on Indonesia is expected in the second week of November.
events.key_numbers: MSCI announcement 12 Nov 2026 · FTSE follow-up 2nd week Nov · FTSE freeze on Indonesia index changes through Dec 2026
events.why_it_matters: Index changes decide how much passive foreign money must leave or stay in Indonesian stocks.
